steps.title: What you are building
Gather the electronics and kit cables
Print the 28 new parts
Tools and consumables
Soldering and wire list
Check the neck and head servo IDs
Flash the UART bridge
Set the power jumper and trim the header tails
Solder the two UART wires into J12
Set the 5991 to 15 V and the two XL4015 to 7.40 V and 5.00 V
Open both hips so the torso base can go in
Check the cables already in each leg
Open the thigh (only on a leg missing a thigh plug)
Plug both thigh servos and slide them back
Plug the ankle servo (only if its plug is missing)
Replace each ankle bracket with the two-half ankle
Fit the slip-fit feet
Close each leg and tie the leg cables
Plug the hip cable into the hip-roll motor
Stack the yaw links, rings, torso base and hip-yaw motors
Fasten each yaw link to its hip-yaw motor
Put the hip-roll motors back into the yaw links
Screw the BNO085 onto the pack rib on the bench
Slide in the rear electronics pack
Fasten the hip-yaw motors to the torso
Slide both legs back onto the hip-roll outputs
Plug the hip cables into ID5 and ID10
Mount the OpenRB-150 in the pack
Connect the 7 V pair and plug in the three links
Plug the leg links into ID5 and ID10
Plug the IMU cable
Screw the Dual Lock back plate onto the pack posts
Stick the rear box frame onto the back plate with Dual Lock
Screw the 5991 into the bottom tier and loop its 15 V wires
Screw in the 5 V converter, then the 7 V converter above it, IN on the right
Lead the 7 V pair and the head 5 V lead to their converters' OUT blocks
Close the box with its cap lid
Seat the two neck motors
Fasten the neck cases and rear centres
Connect ID12 to ID11 (100 mm)
Prepare the yaw motor on the pitch bracket
Join the upper neck to ID11 and connect 11 → 13
Lower the neck into the open torso
Close the two torso shells
Drive the two roof screws into the pack bar, with nothing on the shell roofs yet
On the bench: thermal pad and the 6530B heatsink on the A7Z, the board onto the saddle floor bosses, four screws from below
On the bench: stick the Wi-Fi antenna on the inside of the saddle front wall
Tape the saddle unit onto the torso roof
Push the microSD card in through the notch in the right-hand wall
Plug the torso wires onto the A7Z
Seat ID15 in the jaw support and plug its cable
Check the speaker pocket and the twelve sound holes in the lower head shell
Check the lower head shell
Spring the jaw into the lower shell from below
Prepare the roll motor on the yaw fork
Drop the fork with ID14 into the shell
Set the head on ID13 and connect 13 → 14
Lower the jaw support with ID15 and screw it down
Screw the jaw to the ID15 horn
Wire the speaker to the amplifier on the bench
Tape the speaker face down into its pocket and the amplifier onto the floor beside it
Fit the eye trim into the face panel and screw it from behind
Screw the camera onto the face
Set the face with the camera on the head
Prepare the head cap
Stick the five copper touch pads and the XIAO inside the cap
Fit the two microphones in the ears of the cap
Join the microphone wires into the amplifier and XIAO wires
Optional: fit a third microphone at the back of the cap

Run the 11 (or 12 with the optional back microphone) head wires and the camera cable through the left-rear exit, tie them once inside the head above the exit and run them down the left side of the neck to the saddle
Plug the 11 head wires onto the A7Z
Lower the cap onto the head
Screw the head shut
Unpowered checks
Set up the A7Z software
First power: converter readback, bus scan, Shutdown 52 and voltage-limit check
Check the IMU, Wi-Fi, speaker, microphones, touch pads and the heatsink blower
Close the heatsink end of the saddle with its lid
Range-of-motion check with torque off
Measure the servo current through the OpenRB
Close the mouth and weigh the robot
Take the backpack on the robot apart and keep its parts
Snap the switch into the V1.40 frame floor, rocker down
Clip the DFR1202 behind the front plate, connect plug 2 and lead plugs 3 and 4 out at the lower left rear
Set the battery into the cradle on the V1.40 cap
Screw the two bars across the battery
Put the cap with the battery on the frame
Swap the rear converter box for the battery backpack on the Dual Lock
Close the roof over the battery with the hatch
Connect plug 1 on top of the box and switch on
Swap the battery through the hatch, no tools
飞行背包：先把东西备齐
剪好 16 根线，每根贴上名字
12 根风扇线的长头各焊一个 3.5 mm 母子弹头
12 根风扇线的短头焊到电调的四组电机焊盘
两根电池尾线和电容焊到电调的两片电池片
光流模块拧到支架下面的小平台
右电池尾线穿过支架上的方窗，再焊 XT60 头
左电池尾线穿过翼板左臂的两个筋窗，再焊 XT60 头
支架拧到翼板右臂背后
四个 M3 × 6 尼龙柱拧进支架的四个圆凸台
电调套到尼龙柱上，插上 8 针线，再拧四个隔离柱
飞控插好两根线，扣到隔离柱上，拧四颗尼龙螺丝
一根扎带把电容绑在右臂顶上
左机舱内半贴泡棉胶，放进两个风扇
盖上左机舱外半，五颗 M2 × 10 加垫片轻轻夹住风扇
右机舱内半贴泡棉胶，放进两个风扇
盖上右机舱外半，五颗 M2 × 10 加垫片轻轻夹住风扇
关机，打开电池背包，把背包从 OpenRB 盒子上拿下来
翼板组件贴到 OpenRB 盒子背面
背包外框贴到翼板背面，四颗 M2 × 12 一起拧进 OpenRB 盒子
背包后盖装回去，舱盖盖好
左电池托盘拧到左臂正面
右电池托盘拧到右臂正面
左机舱拧到左臂外端
右机舱拧到右臂外端
左边的线束：从电调绕到背包后面，再沿背包左侧进左臂
右边的线：右前、右后风扇线绕过支架外侧进右臂
12 个子弹头插上，多出来的风扇线扎好
两块 4S 电池放到托盘上绑好，XT60 先不插
转向检查：一次转一个风扇，看风向和转向
A7Z ↔ 飞控线：一头插飞控 UART1，三根杜邦头插 A7Z 的 14、16、18 号针
最后检查：腿、头、进风口
